note: Shared test vectors for skills/scam-shield/signals.yaml (the scam_text signal): tempo_core.signals and apps/android-signal must agree on every one. `expected` is exactly what may leave the phone with the model gate off: the family ids that fired (sorted, comma-joined), the sender's email domain, the links' registrable hosts. null means nothing matched and nothing left. Every message is made up; phone numbers are Ofcom's drama ranges.
